t: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh[1],
secure in their winter and summer journeys[1].
Let them worship the Lord of this [Sacred] House[1],
Who fed them against hunger and made them secure against fear[1].
f: [1] Allah had given Quraysh the honor of being guardians of the Holy Ka‘bah, which allowed them to travel in peace without fear of being harmed.
[1] i.e., their trading caravans would travel south to Yemen in winter and north to the Levant in summer.
[1] The people of Quraysh were blessed with provision and security probably because of the prayer of Abraham. See 14:35-37
